notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
description:
Activate Uthros, Titanic Godcore by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost.
When Venser enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Venser trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Repeat.
